ModMetaData.name: Loadout Quality for Combat Extended
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Quality control for Combat Extended loadouts — the same filters vanilla outfit policies have always had.
- Per-loadout quality and hit-point floors: loadout fetching skips items outside the ranges, and a carried weapon below the floor is dropped and replaced (exactly how apparel outside an outfit filter behaves). Ranges default wide open — the mod does nothing until you narrow them in the loadout dialog. - Auto weapon upgrade (toggleable): pawns swap loadout weapons for higher-quality copies of the same weapon and material when one is available. The old weapon is dropped in place, unforbidden, for your haulers.
Requires Combat Extended. Works fine alongside Simple Sidearms and the CE+SS compatibility suite, but needs neither.
